svg.title: How infrastructure failures propagate
svg.desc: Flooding affects electricity, water and telecom networks. Water services also depend on power and telemetry. Compare protective measures by rerunning the connected scenario.

text.tspan: A flood-resilience example: connect power, water and communications
Where and when does flooding occur?
Conceptual example informed by CReDO’s cross-network work; not a diagram of its implementation.
